# Standardize the HospitalOwner column by removing extra spaces, converting to lowercase, and replacing special characters
def standardize_hospital_owner(value):
    value = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', value).strip()  # remove extra spaces
    value = value.lower()  # convert to lowercase
    value = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9\s]', '', value)  # replace special characters
    return value

# Apply the standardization function on each cell in the HospitalOwner column
def regexr_transform(column):
    for index, row in column.iterrows():
        value = row['HospitalOwner']
        if value:  # check if not null or empty
            value = standardize_hospital_owner(value)
            row['HospitalOwner'] = value
return value
